title: Taxat Schema Compatibility Atlas
subtitle: Inspect deterministic schema drift, migration chronology posture, compatibility windows, and release admissibility without re-deriving source analysis in the browser.
basisStatement: Compare the imported contracts-core schema bundle against a candidate bundle, then join drift, migration posture, reader-window policy, and candidate identity into one deterministic release-readiness verdict.

severityGroups.label: ADDITIVE
severityGroups.summary: Optional widening or new surfaces that preserve current readers by default.

severityGroups.label: NARROWING
severityGroups.summary: Changes that reject formerly valid values or readers without an explicit safety window.

severityGroups.label: DESTRUCTIVE
severityGroups.summary: Removal, re-typing, or sealed-path changes that cannot be assumed rollback-safe.

severityGroups.label: DOC DRIFT
severityGroups.summary: Schema, sample, or documentation parity drift that blocks trustworthy contract evidence.

severityGroups.label: BINDING DRIFT
severityGroups.summary: Generated binding artifacts are stale relative to the current schema bundle.

severityGroups.label: MIGRATION GAP
severityGroups.summary: Migration ledgers, backfill posture, or compatibility windows are missing or incomplete.

chronologyPhases.label: Expand
chronologyPhases.summary: Pre-destructive widening and reader-safe shape additions.

chronologyPhases.label: Backfill
chronologyPhases.summary: Data rewrites and idempotent derivations needed before verification.

chronologyPhases.label: Verify
chronologyPhases.summary: Reader-window and candidate-admissibility checks before contract.

chronologyPhases.label: Contract
chronologyPhases.summary: Post-window cleanup where rollback may already be fail-forward only.

diffCards.accessibleLabel: optional field addition remains rollback safe because existing readers still accept the old payload
diffCards.summary: Optional field added with no migration or reader-window action required.
diffCards.inspectorBody: An optional field widened the schema surface without invalidating historical payloads, bundled samples, or generated bindings.

diffCards.accessibleLabel: enum narrowing blocks promotion because historical replay and supported clients still depend on retired values
diffCards.summary: Enum narrowing breaks replay and the current supported-client window.
diffCards.inspectorBody: The narrowing is semantically breaking, so the candidate must align to a supported-client window before release evidence can claim compatibility.

diffCards.accessibleLabel: destructive field removal blocks promotion until compatibility window closes
diffCards.summary: Field removal has a migration ledger but the reader window is still open.
diffCards.inspectorBody: The destructive contraction is recorded, but protected readers and replay flows still depend on the prior field surface.

diffCards.accessibleLabel: migration ledger exists but missing backfill evidence blocks promotion
diffCards.summary: Migration ledger exists, but the required backfill execution contract is incomplete.
diffCards.inspectorBody: The structure is ready to expand, but semantic data shape is not yet proven because resumable backfill evidence is absent.

diffCards.accessibleLabel: documentation drift blocks promotion because schema tokens still point to the prior contract file
diffCards.summary: Docs heading changed but the schema token still points at an old contract file.
diffCards.inspectorBody: Docs-only edits can mask true contract posture, so promotion blocks until prose, token bindings, and schema identity agree again.

diffCards.accessibleLabel: stale python and swift bindings block release evidence because generated surfaces no longer match the schema bundle
diffCards.summary: Generated Python and Swift bindings are stale relative to the candidate schema bundle.
diffCards.inspectorBody: Generated bindings are evidence-bearing artifacts in this repo, so stale downstreams block promotion even when the source schemas look consistent.

diffCards.accessibleLabel: sealed manifest contraction is admissible only as fail forward after the protection window closes
diffCards.summary: Destructive change on a sealed-manifest path requires explicit fail-forward posture.
diffCards.inspectorBody: Protected promotion evidence already binds this path, so the contract phase is only admissible after the window closes and rollback is no longer promised.

diffCards.accessibleLabel: rename plus sample and documentation drift blocks promotion because semantic intent is no longer provable
diffCards.summary: One semantic rename appears as field removal, replacement field, sample drift, and docs drift.
diffCards.inspectorBody: The automation treats the rename as a bundle of structural and parity deltas so release evidence cannot hand-wave it as a benign refactor.
